articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: Crypto prediction markets are turning into dangerous national security risks, and Congress wants to ban them
articles.snippet: Bubblemaps investigators led by Nicolas Vaiman, discovered 80 bets on Polymarket with a 98% win rate that he said is statistically impossible to achieve.

articles.title: Polymarket moves to list parlays while SEC seeks public input on prediction market ETFs
articles.snippet: The "combinatorial outcome contracts" would resolve if every part of an underlying contract resolved, according to a filing.

articles.title: Crypto Backing or Trump Pump? Fairshake PAC Claims Primary Victories
articles.snippet: Fairshake said six primary victories on Tuesday revealed a “powerful bipartisan mandate” for pro-crypto policies. But other factors appear to have been at play.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Markets Flip Green Overnight Ahead of NVDA Earnings
articles.snippet: Crypto majors and stocks are back in the green, while Polymarket just opened private company prediction markets to retail.
